info.name: Multi-Vendor Marketplace - ADMIN
info.description: Admin panel: admin auth, admin-user/role management, activity logs, dashboard, locations, commissions, settlements, coupons, offers, banners, review moderation, customer support-management, wallet adjustments, payments/refunds visibility, search, uploads, geocoding, and infra health.

item.name: Admin Auth
item.description: Admin login/session endpoints (mounted at /auth/admin via auth.routes.ts).

item.name: Admin Users (Super Admin)
item.description: Platform-level admin-user/role management — SUPER_ADMIN-exclusive by convention.

item.name: Activity Logs
item.description: Audit trail of admin actions across the platform.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Aggregate KPIs for the admin panel home screen.

item.name: Locations
item.description: City/region configuration — every other resource (vendor, store, delivery zone, ...) is scoped to a Location. Access is further gated by requireLocationAccess for non-SUPER_ADMIN roles.

item.name: Commissions

request.description: GLOBAL takes no locationId/vendorId/storeId; LOCATION requires locationId only; VENDOR requires vendorId; STORE requires storeId.

item.description: Platform commission rules, scoped GLOBAL / LOCATION / VENDOR / STORE.

item.name: Settlements
item.description: Payout generation and lifecycle for vendors, stores and delivery partners. Reads are dual-actor (vendor/delivery partner see their own); every write is admin-only.

item.name: Coupons
item.description: Admin-only management surface. Applying a coupon happens as part of POST /orders itself, not through a route here.

item.name: Offers
item.description: Promotional offers shown in the customer/vendor apps. GET /active is public.

item.name: Banners
item.description: Home-screen banner carousels. GET /active is public.

item.name: Reviews (Moderation)

request.description: Public browsing (VISIBLE only). Add the Authorization header with {{adminToken}} to also see HIDDEN reviews.
Public browsing (VISIBLE only). Add the Authorization header with {{adminToken}} to also see a HIDDEN review.

item.description: Browsing is public; moderation (hide/delete) requires REVIEW_MODERATE.

item.name: Customers (Admin)
item.description: Customer account support/management — admin only (customer-driven profile changes go through /auth/customer).

item.name: Wallet (Admin)
item.description: Manual wallet credit/debit — admin only (reads are self-scoped for the customer, see the CUSTOMER collection).

item.name: Payments (Admin)

request.description: Public endpoint — authenticated by Razorpay via an HMAC signature header verified against the raw body, not a JWT. Not meant to be called manually; kept here for reference.

item.description: Admin-side payment visibility (FINANCE_ADMIN / SUPPORT_ADMIN read-only). Initiating/verifying a payment is customer-only — see the CUSTOMER collection.

item.name: Refunds (Admin)

request.description: Manual refunds are admin-initiated only. Cancelling a PAID order triggers an automatic refund on its own — this endpoint is for disputes, goodwill refunds, or retrying a failed auto-refund.

item.description: Refund initiation and visibility — admin only to create; reads are dual-actor (see the CUSTOMER collection for the self-scoped view).

item.name: Uploads
item.description: Stateless media utility shared by every profile/product/banner that needs an image URL. Any authenticated actor type may call this — shown here with {{adminToken}}.

item.name: Geocoding
item.description: Proxies OpenStreetMap Nominatim — any authenticated actor type may call this.

item.name: Health
item.description: Infra liveness checks — mounted under /api/{{apiVersion}}/health like every other route.
